services.intro: OneBranding is a full-cycle branding agency in Tashkent, Uzbekistan: brand strategy and naming, logo design, brand identity, packaging, websites and more, from one team.

audit.asideFirst: A clear view of your business.
audit.asideSecond: A precise plan for what comes next.
audit.text: We examine your business, identify what is holding it back, and map a clear path from point A to point B. Through audit and analysis, we turn data into precise priorities, practical solutions, and a strategy built around measurable goals. You get a roadmap that defines what to change, why it matters, and how to move forward.

clients.text: Restaurant chains, banks, FMCG and retail brands: we create brand identities, packaging, campaigns and presentation materials for companies of every size.

items.q: How does the project process work?
items.a: Every project runs in clear stages: a brief and research into your market, strategy and concept, design, refinement with your feedback, and the final hand-over. You see progress at each step and approve it before we move on.

items.q: How long does it take to develop a brand?
items.a: It depends on the scope. A focused identity usually takes 2 to 6 weeks; a full brand system with naming, packaging or a website takes longer. We agree on the timeline before we start.

items.q: How much does branding cost in Tashkent?
items.a: Branding packages start from $1,900 (Launch Base), $2,900 (One Pro) and $5,900 (Global ultimate); logo design alone starts from $900 and packaging design from $500. The final price depends on the scope we agree after the brief.

Strategy and positioning, naming if needed, the logo and identity system, colours, typography, graphic elements and a brand book with clear rules — plus the applications you need, from packaging to social media and the website.

items.q: Can changes be made during the process?
items.a: Yes. Each stage includes rounds of revisions, and we work closely with you so the result reflects your goals. Larger changes in direction are discussed openly and planned in.

items.q: Do you work with international projects?
items.a: Yes. We work with clients in Uzbekistan and abroad, remotely or on site, in Uzbek, Russian and English, and we design with international markets and standards in mind.
A short conversation about your business, goals and audience. We send you a brief, agree on scope, timeline and price, sign a contract — and start with research.

items.q: Why is the cost above average?
items.a: Because you get a complete system rather than a single logo: research, strategy, a team of specialists and a brand that works across every touchpoint. It is an investment that keeps paying off as your business grows.

items.q: What materials will I receive at the end?
items.a: All final files in the formats you need (vector, print and web), the brand book with usage rules, source files and the agreed applications — everything your team and partners need to use the brand correctly.

aboutPage.title: Meet our team

section2.title: Our mission
section2.text:
We create brands that don’t just exist: they influence.

Every project is a strategic effort for us, where design becomes a tool for growth and competitive advantage.

We combine marketing thinking, deep analysis and strong visual execution to build brands with character. From the idea to the final implementation, every detail is refined and works toward results.

Our mission is to create brands that speak loudly, look confident and sell without unnecessary words.

section2.title: Our vision
section2.text:
We see the future of branding in simplicity, clarity and meaning.

In a world overloaded with information, the brands that win are precise, honest and visually strong.

OneBranding creates identities that stay in memory and build trust.

We believe in minimalism with character, where every line, colour and shape has meaning.

The future belongs to brands that understand their audience and speak its language. That is exactly what we create.

cms.section3Text:
At OneBranding there are no random decisions, only a thoughtful approach, character and responsibility for the result.

That is why our projects don’t just look good: they make an impact.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How OneBranding collects, uses and protects the personal data you send through the contact form on onebrandingworld.com, and how to reach us about it.

p: OneBranding is a branding agency at 18A Amir Temur St., office 5, Tashkent, Uzbekistan. This policy covers the website onebrandingworld.com and the requests sent through its contact form.
When you send a request, we receive what you enter in the form: your name, job title, company, phone number, e-mail, the subject and message of your request and the file you attach.

With the request we also record where your visit came from: the referring website, the first page you opened (with any campaign tags in its address) and the page with the form. It helps us understand which of our pages and channels bring requests.
Only to answer your request: to contact you, prepare a proposal and agree on the work. We do not sell your data or pass it to third parties for their own marketing.
Requests are stored in our website’s content management system, and a notification with the request is sent to our team’s private Telegram chat. Access is limited to the people who handle requests.

If web analytics (Google Analytics or Yandex Metrica) are enabled on the site, they record visits and actions such as sending the form or tapping our phone number, using cookies. They help us improve the site; the data is aggregated and not used to identify you.
We keep requests while we work with you and for as long as is needed to keep a record of our communication, then delete them.
You can ask us what data we hold about you, ask us to correct it or delete it, or withdraw your consent at any time. Call us at +998 93 560 80 00 or write to us through the contact form.
We may update this policy when the site or our processes change. The date at the top shows the latest version.
